digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical whole-file mutant counts in signing.py are stale (814 current vs 491 recorded), including both equivalent survivors and real contract gaps, requiring phased enforcement rather than fixed ceiling.

Three enforcement modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) with different blocking rules must be configured per-shard in .github/mutation-shards.toml as the sole source of truth, with explicit timeout inputs and per-shard policy.

Mutation gate must support selector-derived per-shard matrix jobs with 30-minute caps each, fresh isolated base/head archives with no cached verdicts, and always-published structured evidence and artifacts.

Ratchet mode must preserve unchanged legacy survivors and no-tests outcomes while blocking killed mutants that disappear or become survived, but must report newly introduced no-tests without blocking.

Shards must be promoted to ratchet only after three successful base/head pilot runs with stable mappings and maximum 24-minute runtime, and to strict only after legacy non-killed outcomes are remediated or individually reviewed.
Documentation must define phased promotion policy, manifest authority, and false-positive handling, with contract test validating required sections and rejecting legacy score or budget tables.
